Rays Beat Guardians to Even ALCS Series

The Tampa Bay Rays defeated the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 to even the American League Championship Series (ALCS). Game 3 of the series was scheduled to be played in the afternoon due to a rain forecast for Thursday night.
